title: [Exclusive] Uber Director of Legal Kanishk leaves to join Google as India Legal Head
description: Uber Director of Legal Kanishk has resigned and is moving to Google as India Legal Head.Google confirmed to Bar & Bench that he will join the tech giant in September 2026.Kanishk is a 2007 alumnus of the West Bengal National University of Juridical Services (WBNUJS) Kolkata.With nearly two decades of experience, he specialises in mergers & acquisitions, defence procurement and general corporate advisory.He started his career at the erstwhile Amarchand Mangaldas, before moving on to Shard
